1 简介Introduction

近年来，深度学习的新型优化器设计重新兴起，特别是通过使用“矩阵形”归一化或Recent years have seen a resurgence in the design of novel optimizers for deep learning, particularly via the use of “matrix-shaped” normalization or预处理preconditioning。这些优化器通过“预处理”矩阵调整梯度更新，以重新加权下降方向。成功的亮点是改进. These optimizers adjust gradient updates by a “preconditioning” matrix to reweight the descent direction. The successes highlight improved收敛时间convergence time关于训练或验证损失，例如on training or validation loss, such as洗发水Shampoo (gupta2018shampoo; anil2020scalable; shi2023distributed)赢得 AlgoPerf 优化器竞赛winning the AlgoPerf optimizer competition(mlcommons2024algoperf)通过整体“每单位计算的保留错误”指标来衡量，以及as measured by an overall “holdout error per unit compute” metric, and介子Muon (jordan2024muon)在大幅缩短 NanoGPT 预训练的“目标验证损失时间”方面表现出色，并在训练生产规模的语言模型中得到采用coming to prominence in greatly accelerating low “time to target validation loss” on NanoGPT pretraining and seeing adoption in training production-scale language models(team2025kimi).

这些成功隐含地假设训练目标的低泛化误差意味着良好的下游性能，例如通过@These successes implicitly assume that low generalization error on the training objective implies good downstream performance, e.g. pass@kk在语言推理的背景下。然而，人们广泛指出，验证损失可能无法跟踪自然性能指标。 两者在我们称之为的政权下存在分歧in the context of language reasoning. However, it has been widely noted that validation loss may not track natural performance metrics. The two diverge under a regime we call测试时反馈test-time feedback(TTF)，普遍存在于 当代深度学习，其中一(TTF), ubiquitous in contemporary deep learning, in which one针对每步监督目标进行训练trains on per-step supervised objectives，而部署涉及, while deployment involves根据模型自己的预测推出多个步骤rolling out multiple steps according to the model’s own predictions。 主要例子包括：(1). Key examples include: (1)机器人策略学习robot policy learning其中沿着专家轨迹的每步（或每块）模仿专家动作，并且部署涉及使用学习到的策略的动作和（2）自回归where per-step (or per-chunk) imitation of expert actions along expert trajectories, and deployment involves rolling out using the learned policy’s actions and (2) autoregressive法学硕士培训LLM training其中模型通过下一个令牌预测进行训练，但通过自回归采样进行部署。在这些设置中，顺序部署可能会导致输入的分布（例如，语言建模中的上下文标记）与训练分布的分布不同，从而导致仅由模型自身的预测误差驱动的分布变化。这种“TTF 转变”在机器人技术中得到了广泛证明in which models are trained via next-token prediction, yet deployed via autoregressive sampling. In these settings, sequential deployment can cause the distribution of inputs (e.g., context tokens in language modeling) to diverge from that of the training distribution, leading to distribution shift driven solely by the model’s own prediction errors. This “TTF shift” is widely attested in both robotics(ross2011reduction; simchowitz2025pitfalls)以及长视野语言生成（例如，and in long-horizon language generation (e.g.,(bengio2015scheduled; ranzato2015sequence; song2023consistency)）。 受这些发现和深度学习优化器设计的最新成就的启发，我们提出以下问题：). Motivated by these findings and recent achievements in deep-learning optimizer design, we ask:

是否存在针对深度学习优化器的轻量级、普遍适用的干预措施的设计空间，以改进Is there a design space for lightweight, generally applicable interventions on deep learning optimizers that target improved下游表现？downstream performance?

贡献。Contributions. 第一First，我们在之间建立严格的联系, we establish a rigorous connection between分布转移distribution shift由 TTF 诱导和induced by TTF and不完美的特征学习imperfect feature learning在当今流行的优化器中，仅使用梯度统计来预处理更新（例如under today’s popular optimizers that precondition updates solely using gradient statistics (e.g.kingma2014adam; kellerjordan/cifar10-airbench）。具体来说，我们观察到，当每一层的激活/输入都是非各向同性时，特征学习就会受到影响，从而产生错误，从而在 TTF 下不成比例地驱动分布偏移。而且，这些). Specifically, we observe that when activations/inputs at each layer are non-isotropic, feature learning suffers, which induces errors that can disproportionately drive distribution shift under TTF. 2 在测试时反馈下学习Learning under Test-Time Feedback

我们研究下面的学习问题We study the problem of learning under测试时反馈test-time feedback（TTF）——我们的目标是学习一个模型，该模型部署在与自己的世代（如语言建模）或环境（如机器人技术）的反馈中。 我们将 TTF 形式化 作为行为克隆的问题(TTF) — where our goal is to learn a model that is deployed in feedback with its own generations (as in language modeling) or with the environment (as in robotics). We formalize TTF as a problem of behavior cloning(pomerleau1988alvinn)在马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中。考虑具有状态的有限范围 MDPin a Markov Decision Process (MDP). 机器人行为克隆。Robotic behavior cloning.

在机器人技术中，In robotics,𝐬\mathbf{s}对应于机器人和环境状态，并且corresponds to the robot and environment state, and𝐚\mathbf{a}到机器人的动作。在实践中，to the robot actions. In practice,𝐬\mathbf{s}被机器人观察（例如像素、触觉）和动作所取代is replaced by robot observations (e.g., pixels, tactile), and actions𝐚\mathbf{a}可能是短序列或“动作块”。早期作品参数化高斯策略may be short sequences or “action-chunks”. Proposition˜3.2表明，通过分布内验证损失更好地衡量的模型可以隐藏明显较差的特征学习，因此即使假设下游层可以重新训练，TTF 也会变得更差。一个自然的问题是是否可以鼓励更好的特征学习，作为与验证损失性能分开的考虑因素。demonstrates that a model that appears better measured by in-distribution validation loss can hide significantly poorer feature learning, and can thus suffer vastly worse TTF, even assuming the downstream layers can be retrained. A natural question would be whether one can encourage better feature learning, as a separate consideration from validation loss performance.

4.3 梯度预处理和超参数缩放Gradient-Preconditioning and Hyperparameter Scaling for多普勒DoPr

为新型优化器上的大规模训练运行确定有利的超参数可能具有挑战性。这是“最大更新参数化”背后的关键动机 (P)Determining favorable hyperparameters for large-scale training runs on a novel optimizer can prove challenging. This is a key motivation behind the “maximum-update parameterization” (P)(yang2022tensor; dey2025don)，其中的总体目标是使超参数选择在网络规模（例如宽度和深度）上保持不变；看到, where the broad goal is to make hyperparameter choices invariant across network scales (e.g., width and depth); seeSection˜C.4进行充分讨论。 一旦实现尺度不变，超参数就可以在小规模上进行调整，并将零样本转移到大规模运行中。最近的工作表明，实际上 P 很大程度上是由粗略统计数据决定的，例如更新方向的大小for full discussion. Once made scale-invariant, hyperparameters can be tuned at small-scale and zero-shot transferred to the large-scale run. Recent work has demonstrated that in practice P is largely determined by coarse statistics such as the magnitude of the update direction(yang2023spectral; hong2025provable)。因此，除了实际的稳定和加速性能之外. Thus, in addition to the practical stabilizing and accelerating properties ofGPs，使用的一个主要好处s, a key benefit of usingGP进入s in多普勒DoPr如下所示：虽然为新优化器导出扩展规则通常很费力，但is as follows: whereas deriving scaling rules for a new optimizer can often be laborious, the正常化normalizing的财产property ofGP简化了这个过程trivializes this process for多普勒DoPr.

6 讨论Discussion

为了优化下游性能的最终目标，我们：1. 引入测试时反馈作为许多现代应用程序的统一设置，2. 识别加速训练收敛的特征与 TTF 下敏感特征之间的不匹配，3. 规定双重预处理（Toward the ultimate goal of optimizing for downstream performance, we: 1. introduce Test-Time Feedback as a unified setting for many modern applications, 2. identify the mismatch between features that accelerate training convergence versus those sensitive under TTF, 3. prescribe Double Preconditioning (多普勒DoPr）结合了激活预处理（) that combines Activation Preconditioning (AP）均衡特征学习和梯度预处理（) to equalize feature learning and Gradient Preconditioning (GP）以稳定训练。我们提供 TTF 证据并) to stabilize training. We provide evidence for TTF and多普勒DoPr通过跨不同 TTF 应用程序的实验成为有用的抽象。重要的是，我们发现下游性能的提高可能不会伴随训练/验证损失的改善，这表明仍然存在可行的设计空间来改进与加速损失收敛正交的深度学习优化。值得注意的是，我们提出的结合激活预处理和梯度预处理的方案只是双重预处理的候选方案之一。我们假设对方向性进行解耦考虑（例如，being useful abstractions via experiments across distinct TTF applications. Importantly, we find that improved downstream performance may not accompany improved train/validation loss, suggesting that there remains a viable design space for improving deep learning optimization that is orthogonal to accelerating loss convergence. Notably, our proposed recipe of combining activation- and gradient-preconditioning is just one candidate of double preconditioning; we posit that decoupling considerations for directionality (e.g.,AP）和适应性（例如，) and adaptivity (e.g.,GP）可能会带来富有成效的优化器设计。我们以一个问题作为结束：) may lead to fruitful optimizer design. 模仿学习和复合错误问题。Imitation learning and the compounding errors problem.

复合误差问题已被认为是示范数据政策学习的一个基本问题The compounding errors problem has been recognized as a fundamental issue in policy learning from demonstration data[pomerleau1988alvinn]，其中小的一步学习错误可能会使学习的模型偏离其训练的离线数据分布，从而导致潜在的灾难性失败。减轻复合错误的传统方法来自修改数据收集，或者通过恢复行为的迭代在线收集, where small one-step learning errors may shift the learned model away from the offline data distribution it was trained on, leading to potentially catastrophic failure. Traditional approaches to mitigating compounding error come from modifying data collection, either through iterative online collection of recovery behavior[ross2011reduction, kelly2019hg, foster2024behavior]或噪音动作执行or noising action execution[laskey2017dart, zhang2025action]更好地围绕数据分布局部调整策略几何结构。最近，修改to better regularize the policy geometry locally around the data distribution. More recently, modifying策略参数化policy parameterization已被探索作为实现一致的长期顺序部署的干预措施，例如使用迭代监督方法（例如，扩散和基于流的参数化）has been explored as an intervention for enabling consistent longer-horizon sequential deployment, such as the use of iteratively supervised methods (e.g., diffusion and flow-based parameterizations)[chi2023diffusion, pan2025much]和动作分块（即多步骤预测和执行）and action-chunking (i.e., multi-step prediction and execution)[shafiullah2022behavior, chi2023diffusion, liu2025bidirectional]。因此，虽然数据收集和架构设计一直是减轻复合误差的主要途径，但相对较少的焦点集中在深度学习的作用上。. Therefore, while data-collection and architecture design have been the primary avenues for mitigating compounding error, comparatively less focus has been directed to the role of the deep learning优化器optimizer。值得注意的一个例外是. An exception of note isblock2024butterfly，它确定基于梯度的神经网络训练中的小损失波动可能会导致行为克隆设置中不成比例的大甚至振荡性能波动，这与我们的核心论文完全一致，即通过训练损失测量的小错误方向在推出时可能会产生不成比例的危害。他们提出的干预措施是通过维护模型参数的 EMA 副本进行评估来减少方差的方法，这是对我们的预处理方法的补充，因此我们在连续空间 BC 实验中采用了这种方法。在大多数其他文献中，优化器被避免作为预言机产生（近似）经验风险最小化器（参见例如，, which identifies that small loss fluctuations in gradient-based neural network training can cause disproportionately large or even oscillatory performance fluctuations in behavior cloning settings, precisely aligning with our core thesis that small error directions as measured by training loss can be disproportionately harmful when rolled out. Their proposed intervention is a variance-reduction approach via maintaining an EMA-ed copy of the model parameters for evaluation, which is complementary to our preconditioning approach, and as such we adopt in our continuous-space BC experiments. In most other literature, the optimizer is obviated as an oracle yielding (approximate) empirical risk minimizers (see e.g.,ross2011reduction, foster2024behavior, zhang2025action）。然而，深度学习优化器的作用在深度强化学习中受到了相对更多的关注，这可能是由于强化学习相对于监督学习带来的复杂困难，例如输入和目标的非平稳性). However, the role of specifically the deep learning optimizer has received comparably more attention in deep reinforcement learning, likely due to the compounding difficulties RL presents over supervised learning, such as input- and target- nonstationarity[lyle2022learning, sokar2023dormant, castanyer2025stable]。在本文中，我们揭示了各种深度学习优化器的潜在次优性. In this paper, we expose the potential suboptimalities of a wide range of deep learning optimizers that arise 即使在相对简单的离线监督 TTF 设置中even in comparatively simpler offline supervised TTF settings，比如行为克隆。, such as behavior cloning.

When used as a preconditioner for local optimization in maximum likelihood estimation, the resulting method is known as the自然梯度法natural gradient method。从这个角度来看，Fisher信息在某些情况下与其他曲率矩阵如Hessian（或其广义高斯-牛顿近似）有关，因此在可行的情况下，自然梯度法通常会大大加速优化；参见例如. From this perspective, the Fisher Information in some cases is related to other curvature matrices such as the Hessian (or the Generalized Gauss-Newton approximation thereof), thus in settings where feasibly implementable, the natural gradient method often greatly accelerates optimization; see e.g.,[amari1998natural, amari2000methods, martens2020new]。针对神经网络，其参数太多，完全二阶方法不可行，因此提出了费舍尔信息的因式分解版本. 神经网络特征学习理论。Neural network feature learning theory.

目前理解神经网络如何学习的经典方法是通过神经正切核（NTK）A by now classical approach to understanding how neural networks learn is via the neural tangent kernel (NTK)[jacot2018neural, mei2022generalization]。然而，核方法依赖于固定的特征，这从根本上限制了它们的表达能力，并导致学习非线性函数的样本复杂度不理想. However, kernel methods rely on fixed, features, which fundamentally limits their expressivity and leads to suboptimal sample complexity for learning nonlinear functions[ghorbani2021linearized, ghorbani2021neural]。 这激发了后续大量研究神经网络特征学习的工作。在设置中. This has motivated a large body of subsequent work studying feature learning in neural networks. In the setting of各向同性协变量isotropic covariates，已经证明，只要目标函数具有低维结构，即使在两层网络的第一层上执行 SGD 的单个步骤也可以学习足够多的信息特征，以实现比核方法更高的样本复杂性, it has been shown that even a single step of SGD on the first layer of a two-layer network can learn sufficiently informative features to achieve improved sample complexity over kernel methods, provided the target function has low-dimensional structure[damian2022neural, moniri2024asymptotics]。相反，对于一般的各向异性协变量，. In contrast, for general anisotropic covariates,zhang2023meta和andzhang2025concurrence发现 SGD 因输入的各向异性而严重扭曲，这可能导致学习的表示和地面实况表示之间的子空间距离增大，即使训练损失减少也是如此。他们通过分层预处理方案解决了这个问题；所提出的算法identify that SGD is heavily distorted by anistropy of the inputs, which can cause the subspace distance between the learned and ground-truth representations to grow, even as training loss decreases. They reconcile this issue with a layerwise preconditioning schemes; the proposed algorithm inzhang2023meta是纯的两层版本is a two-layer version of pureAP（或同等地(or equivalently多普勒DoPr-GD).

超参数缩放条件。Hyperparameter scaling conditions.

一项补充工作研究优化器超参数如何随着模型宽度、深度和参数化进行扩展，以确保稳定的训练和超参数传输。张量程序框架A complementary line of work studies how optimizer hyperparameters should scale with model width, depth, and parameterization to ensure stable training and hyperparameter transfer. The Tensor Programs framework[yang2019wide, yang2020tensor]提供了无限宽度限制和最大更新参数化（P）的统一理论provides a unifying theory of infinite-width limits, and maximal update parameterization (P)[yang2021tensor, yang2022tensor]导出保持激活的学习率和初始化缩放derives learning-rate and initialization scalings that keep activations(1)\Theta(1)同时保留跨宽度的最大特征学习。后续工作将这些原理扩展到二阶和矩阵预处理优化器，例如while preserving maximal feature learning across widths. Subsequent work extends these principles to second-order and matrix-preconditioned optimizers such as肯德基FACKFAC和and洗发水Shampoo [ishikawa2023parameterization]，基于谱范数的替代公式, alternative formulations based on spectral norms[yang2023spectral]、深度缩放法则和残差乘数, depth-wise scaling laws and residual multipliers[dey2025don, yang2024depth]，以及较新的优化器，包括, and newer optimizers including肥皂SOAP和and介子Muon [qiu2025hyperparameter]。最近的工作进一步表明，对于长时间的训练，权重衰减缩放可以主导稳定性，一些工作提倡恒定的学习率-权重衰减乘积. Recent work further shows that for long training runs, weight decay scaling can dominate stability, with some works advocating constant learning-rate–weight-decay products[wang2025setadamsweightdecay, kosson2025weightdecaymattermup]和其他人提出了宽度相关的权重衰减缩放and others proposing width-dependent weight decay scaling[qiu2025hyperparameter]。从广义上讲，这些方法通常通过单步更新分析来导出特定于优化器的缩放规则，以实现跨模型大小的高效超参数调整。我们的工作可以轻松整合这些发现：通过分层. Broadly, these methods derive optimizer-specific scaling rules, often through single-step update analyses, to enable efficient hyperparameter tuning across model sizes. Our work enables painless integration of these findings: by layering theGP在这些作品的基础上进行了研究s studied in these works on top of theAP更新后，我们能够立即使用这些缩放规则。update, we are able to make immediate use of these scaling rules.

训练表现与下游行为之间不匹配。Mismatch between training performance and downstream behavior.

除了轶事或民间传说认为优化器甚至超参数的训练/验证损失不需要与更好的下游性能相关之外，还有各种工作试图理解或改善这种现象。从优化的角度来看，最近的工作已经发现，增加预训练工作（从而提高训练性能）可能会导致下游可微调性变差Beyond anecdotal or folklore understanding that training/validation loss across optimizers or even hyperparameters need not correlate to better downstream performance, there have been various works trying to understand or ameliorate this phenomenon. From the optimization perspective, recent work has identified that increasing pre-training effort (thus improving training performance) may lead to worse downstream finetunability[springer2025overtrained, horoi2025less]。另一方面，自 Chinchilla 以来的作品. On the other hand, works since Chinchilla[hoffmann2022training]一直支持预训练每参数标记缩放法则在实践中可以大得多have steadily supported that pretraining token-per-parameter scaling laws can be in practice be much larger[gadre2025language]同时下游性能得到改善；值得注意的是，这包括著名的开放重量模型，例如while downstream performance improves; notably, this includes prominent open-weight models such as骆驼3Llama 3 [meta2024introducing]。除了数据量和训练持续时间等粗略优化干预之外，LLM 微调背景下的某些工作已经发现，在预训练和微调期间使用不同的优化器时，下游性能的次优性，例如，. Beyond coarse optimization interventions such as data quantity and training duration, certain works in the context of LLM fine-tuning have identified suboptimality in downstream performance when using different optimizers during pretraining and finetuning, e.g.,亚当Adam与v.s.介子Muon，特别是Moonshot的白皮书中介绍了大规模, notably documented in Moonshot’s whitepaper introducing large-scale介子Muon-训练模型以及后续研究-trained models, as well as follow-up studies[liu2026optimizer]。我们注意到我们的微调实验使用开放权重预训练模型，因此使用. We note that our fine-tuning experiments use open-weight pre-trained models, and thus using多普勒DoPr对于微调背离优化器一致性范例 - 仍有待验证： 1. 是否使用预训练for finetuning departs from the optimizer-consistency paradigm—it remains to verify: 1. if pretraining with多普勒DoPr可以进一步扩展其好处，2.如果我们观察到使用can further extend its benefits, 2. if our observed benefits using多普勒DoPr用于大规模微调和通用架构。 从与我们关于“统一”特征学习的好处的相关角度来看，一些作品提出使用锐度感知最小化（SAM）及其扩展作为for finetuning hold at scale and for general architectures. In a related perspective to ours regarding the benefits of “uniform” feature learning, some works have proposed using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) and extensions thereof as an优化optimization干预以使模型在下游任务上获得更好的零样本或少样本性能intervention to yield better zero-shot or few-shot performance of the model on downstream tasks[foret2021sharpness, bahri2022sharpness, zhao2022penalizing]，即使以（预）训练验证损失为代价, even at the cost of (pre-)training validation loss[watts2026sharpness]。然而，SAM 能够产生可靠效益的机制以及它实际产生的特征几何形状并不一定反映 SAM 的名义目的. However, the mechanisms behind when SAM can yield reliable benefits as well as the feature geometry it actually induces do not necessarily reflect the nominal purpose of SAM[andriushchenko2023sharpness, schapiro2024towards];在同样的光线下，; in the same light, 精确的机制the precise mechanisms by which多普勒DoPr——或者任何现代的优化器——总体上产量的提高在很大程度上仍然没有得到很好的理解。—or any modern optimizer—yield improvements in general remain largely ill-understood.

作为平行的文献，许多作品都在训练目标上探索了代理统计数据或指标，超越了天真保留/验证损失，以预测下游性能、鲁棒性或适应性。作为一个小样本，我们重点介绍了一些探索的作品As a parallel line of literature, many works have explored proxy statistics or metrics beyond naive held-out/validation loss on the training objective toward predicting downstream performance, robustness, or adaptability. As a small sample, we highlight certain works that explore共同jointly考虑梯度和激活统计accounting for gradient- and activation-statistics[liu2026measure, liu2026spectral]。在. Inliu2026measure，在保持 RL 网络可塑性的背景下提出了梯度加权激活统计量，这种现象导致网络的大部分容量被无声地浪费；值得注意的是，在强化学习环境中，训练目标是非平稳的，因此瞬时训练损失的预测性通常不如监督学习。由于我们的工作重点是监督环境，因此我们离开调查, a gradient-weighted activation statistic is proposed in the context of maintaining plasticity in RL networks, a phenomenon by which much of a network’s capacity is silently wasted; notably, in RL contexts the training objective is nonstationary, and thus instantaneous training losses are often less predictive than in supervised learning. As our work focuses on supervised contexts, we leave investigating多普勒DoPr在强化学习环境中对未来工作的有效性。最后，我们注意到有证据警告使用内部网络统计数据来得出下游性能；例如最近的研究发现，某些通常与更好/更差的下游绩效相关的网络趋势可能反映了当前的培训实践，而不是与绩效的因果关系’s effectiveness in RL contexts for future work. Lastly, we note evidence cautioning using internal network statistics for concluding downstream performance; e.g. recent work finds that certain network trends typically associated with better/worse downstream performance may rather reflect current training practices, rather than a causal relationship with performance[kulkarni2026disentangling, liu2026spectral].

B.3 近似方案Approximation Schemes forAP

对于较大的模型，特别是具有 2d 卷积的模型，存储和计算预处理器中使用的完整激活协方差可能会很昂贵。为了颠覆这种成本，我们开发了多种预处理近似方案。For larger models, particularly those with 2d convolutions, storing and computing the full activation covariance used in the preconditioner can be expensive. To subvert this cost, we develop multiple preconditioning approximation schemes.

B.6 局限性Limitations

多普勒DoPr会产生不小的计算和内存开销。对于具有输入维度的线性层incurs a nontrivial computational and memory overhead. For a linear layer with input dimensiondind_{\mathrm{in}}，输出维度, output dimensiondoutd_{\mathrm{out}}和批量大小, and batch sizeNN，每步开销包括累积输入协方差、分解阻尼预处理器以及将逆预处理器应用于梯度：, the per-step overhead consists of accumulating the input covariance, factoring the damped preconditioner, and applying the inverse preconditioner to the gradient:

𝐒=𝐗⊤​𝐗,𝐗∈RB×din,\mathbf{S}=\mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{X},\qquad\mathbf{X}\in\mdmathbb{R}^{B\times d_{\mathrm{in}}},

大约花费which costs approximatelyB​din2Bd_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}FLOP（由于对称性FLOPs (due to symmetry of𝐒\mathbf{S}。计算阻尼矩阵的 Cholesky 分解. Computing the Cholesky factorization of the damped matrix𝐀=𝐒+I∈Rdin×din\mathbf{A}=\mathbf{S}+\lambda I\in\mdmathbb{R}^{d_{\mathrm{in}}\times d_{\mathrm{in}}}成本大约costs approximately13​din3\frac{1}{3}d_{\mathrm{in}}^{3}失败。最后，将逆预处理器应用于权重梯度FLOPs. Finally, applying the inverse preconditioner to the weight gradient

𝐆​(𝐒+𝐈)−1,𝐆∈Rdout×din,\mathbf{G}(\mathbf{S}+\lambda\mathbf{I})^{-1},\qquad\mathbf{G}\in\mdmathbb{R}^{d_{\mathrm{out}}\times d_{\mathrm{in}}},

通过两个三角形解决成本via two triangular solves costs2​din2​dout2d_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}d_{\mathrm{out}}失败。因此，每层每步的总理想化 FLOP 开销为FLOPs. Thus, the total per-layer per-step idealized FLOP overhead is

N​din2+13​din3+2​din2​dout.\boxed{Nd_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}+\frac{1}{3}d_{\mathrm{in}}^{3}+2d_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}d_{\mathrm{out}}}.

根据经验知识（例如，参见In line with empirical know-how (see e.g.,jordan2024muon），在大批量情况下，形成激活协方差的成本), in the large-batch regime, the cost of forming the activation covariance𝐒=𝐗⊤​𝐗\mathbf{S}=\mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{X}占主导地位。因此，对于层，其中dominates. Thus, for layers wheredin≈doutd_{\mathrm{in}}\approx d_{\mathrm{out}}，开销大约等于额外的前向传递。事实上，在我们的整个实验中，我们发现开销是, the overhead is approximately equal to an additional forward pass. Indeed, throughout our experiments, we found the overhead to be≈1.25​x\approx 1.25x在挂钟时间内，与向后传递的估计相称in wall-clock time, commensurate with the estimate of a backward pass equal to∼3\sim 3向前传球，这样forward passes, such thatAP的开销粗略地得出’s overhead coarsely comes out to5/4=1.25×5/4=1.25\times常规反向传播。regular backprop.

多普勒DoPr还因存储矩阵值预处理器统计数据而引入额外的内存开销。对于指数移动平均线 (EMA)，这需要存储一个also introduces additional memory overhead from storing the matrix-valued preconditioner statistics. With an exponential moving average (EMA), this requires storing onedin×dind_{\mathrm{in}}\times d_{\mathrm{in}}每个预处理层的对称矩阵，即symmetric matrix per preconditioned layer, i.e.,∼din2/2\sim d_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}/2每层优化器状态的附加参数。additional parameters of optimizer state per layer.

我们目前的实施Our current implementation of多普勒DoPr只支持分布式数据并行，不支持FSDP等模型参数分片。然而，除了现有的相关矩阵预处理方法（例如only supports Distributed Data Parallelism, and not model parameter sharding such as FSDP. However, we do not anticipate any fundamental barriers for such schemes beyond existing related matrix-preconditioning methods such as洗发水Shampoo，具有分布式和分片实现, which have distributed and sharded implementations[shi2023distributed, ahn2025dion]。 最后，. Finally,多普勒DoPr可以对矩阵求逆求解器和阻尼参数的选择敏感。在实践中，我们发现 PyTorch 的 Cholesky 求解与跟踪缩放阻尼一起提供了足够稳定和有效的默认值。can be sensitive to the choice of matrix-inversion solver and damping parameter. In practice, we found PyTorch’s Cholesky solve together with trace-scaled damping to provide a sufficiently stable and effective default.

多普勒DoPr可能会在不改善训练或验证损失的情况下改善下游性能，并且可能不会改善相对于基础的训练损失收敛may improve downstream performance without improving training or validation loss, and it may not improve training-loss convergence relative to the baseGP优化器。而且，准确optimizer. Moreover, exactAP对于卷积层或其他权重共享层来说，由于展开可能会产生大量的内存开销。虽然我们引入近似方案来解释其中的冗余，但开发硬件加速近似和探索模型优化器协同设计仍然是未来工作的重要方向。for convolutional or other weight-sharing layers can incur substantial memory overhead due to unfolding. While we introduce approximation schemes to account for the redundancy therein, developing hardware-accelerated approximations and exploring model–optimizer codesign remain important directions for future work.

最后，我们观察到较大的辍学率可能会与Finally, we observe that large dropout rates can conflict withAP由于将激活的随机子集清零，EMA 会缓冲并加速过时；因此，在我们目前的实践中，我们建议使用无压差或低压差。原则上，我们注意到更新激活缓冲区的更高级方案（例如，类似于EMA buffers and accelerate staleness due to zero-ing out random subsets of activations; therefore, in our current practice, we recommend using no or low dropout. In principle, we note more advanced schemes for updating the activation buffer (e.g., analogous toahn2025dion2）存在，但可能需要根据架构的实现方式进行具体处理。 提高兼容性) exist, but may require case-by-case treatment depending on how the architecture is implementated. Improving the compatibility of多普勒DoPr辍学留待将来的工作。with dropout is left for future work.

C.1 一般操作指南General Operating Guideline

在实践中，我们总结了一小部分操作指南，我们发现这些指南在各种环境中广泛有用。In practice, we summarize a small set of operating guidelines that we have found to be broadly useful across settings.

  • •

    适用于极小批量、连续值输入的 EMA 平滑。EMA smoothing for very small-batch, continuous-valued inputs.对于连续值输入（与法学硕士中的离散令牌嵌入相反），我们建议应用于For continuous-valued inputs (in contrast to discrete-token embeddings in LLMs), we suggest applying to theAP当批量大小显着小于模型宽度时，激活协方差和梯度的指数移动平均值 (EMA) 可以减少更新方差。我们注意到，如果an exponential moving average (EMA) to both the activation covariance and gradient to reduce update variance when the batch size is significantly smaller than the model width. We note that appropriate considerations should be made if theGP选择还包含 EMA，因为这可能会在梯度上双重应用平滑。of choice also contains EMAs, as this may doubly apply smoothing on the gradient.

  • •

    使用无/低压差。Use no/low dropout.辍学Dropout[srivastava2014dropout]旨在防止网络中功能之间的虚假共同适应。首先，由于每次更新屏蔽不同的激活子集，大的丢失可能与激活预处理器缓冲区中的累积发生冲突，从而加速陈旧。此外，is designed to prevent spurious co-adaptation between features in the network. Firstly, due to masking different subsets of activations per update, large dropout can conflict with accumulation in the activation preconditioner buffers, accelerating staleness. Furthermore,AP可以被视为类似地从其激活（即特征）相关性中消除梯度偏差。因此，我们建议在大多数设置中不使用 dropout，或者在大规模卷积架构中减少 dropout 的数量。can be viewed as similarly de-biasing the gradient from its activation (i.e. feature) correlations. Therefore, we recommend using no dropout for most settings, or reduced amounts in large-scale convolutional architectures.

  • •

    处理高冗余/权重共享层。Handling high-redundancy/weight-sharing layers. AP对于线性层来说是最直接导出的。对于具有高冗余和权重共享属性的层（例如卷积层），精确的is most directly derived for linear layers. For layers that have high-redundancy and weight-sharing properties, such as convolutional layers, the exactAP（由于(resulting fromProposition˜4.2）可能会因展开而产生不必要的大量内存开销。 遵循克罗内克因子预处理器的先前文献) can incur needlessly large memory overhead from unfolding. Following prior literature in Kronecker-Factored preconditioners[grosse2016kronecker, george2018fast]，我们可以得出一个有效的近似, we may derive an efficient approximation ofAP根据经验，保留了完整的性能that empirically preserves the performance of the fullAP如as inSection˜B.3.2。我们还注意到，大量权重共享的动机之一是使. We also note that one of the motivations of heavy weight-sharing is to make the建筑学architecture“条件很好”“well-conditioned”[wilson2017marginal, keskar2017improving, xiao2018dynamical]，因此对于我们旨在处理严重各向异性的优化器来说可能是部分冗余的。由于我们在这项工作中不修改基线模型架构，因此我们将探索模型优化器协同设计留到未来的工作中。, and thus may be partially redundant to our optimizer that is designed to handle heavy anisotropy. As we do not modify baseline model architectures in this work, we leave exploring model-optimizer co-design for future work.

C.8 生成建模Generative Modeling

TTF 生成建模。Generative modeling as TTF.

生成建模是一种自然的 TTF 设置：训练是本地教师强制的速度回归，而部署则在其自己的诱导轨迹下推出学习的速度场。与流量匹配一样，该模型最大限度地减少了错误Generative modeling is a natural TTF setting: training is local teacher-forced velocity regression, whereas deployment rolls out the learned velocity field under its own induced trajectory. As in flow matching, the model minimizes errors on(𝐱t,𝐲t)({\color[rgb]{0,0,0.55}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0.55}\mathbf{x}_{t}},{\color[rgb]{0,0,0.55}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0.55}\mathbf{y}_{t}}), 其中, where𝐲t=𝐯​(𝐱t,t){\color[rgb]{0,0,0.55}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0.55}\mathbf{y}_{t}}=\mathbf{v}({\color[rgb]{0,0,0.55}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0.55}\mathbf{x}_{t}},t)是封闭形式的目标速度。然而，在生成时，样本是通过迭代集成学习领域来生成的，例如is the closed-form target velocity. At generation time, however, samples are produced by iteratively integrating the learned field, e.g.dd​t​𝐳^t=𝐯^​(𝐱^t,t)\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}{\color[rgb]{0.5,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0.5,0,0}\widehat{\mathbf{z}}_{t}}={\color[rgb]{0.5,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0.5,0,0}\widehat{\mathbf{v}}}({\color[rgb]{0.5,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0.5,0,0}\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{t}},t)，因此速度误差会累积并使未来状态偏离训练分布。因此，每步训练损失可能与最终样本质量指标（例如 FID）不一致。, so velocity errors can accumulate and shift future states away from the training distribution. Consequently, per-step training loss can misalign with final sample quality metrics such as FID.

值得注意的是，如在Notably, as seen inFigure˜17，FID 的相对改进与, the relative improvements in FID are somewhat proportional to改进improvements在列车损失收敛中。我们假设生成建模是一种相对独特的 TTF 设置，因为人们可以控制数据生成动力系统。例如，许多作品研究“拉直”传输轨迹（参见标准流量匹配与整流流量in train loss convergence. We hypothesize that generative modeling is a relatively unique TTF setting, in that one has control over the data-generating dynamical system. For example, many works study “straightening” the transport trajectory (cf. standard flow matching versus Rectified Flow[liu2023flow]和最佳传输 CFMand Optimal-Transport CFM[tong2024improving]），可以实现低 NFE 采样。因此，TTF 的严重性与生成算法有关。 我们将探索这个空间以进行未来工作的协同设计。), which can enable low NFE sampling. Therefore, the severity of TTF is tied to the generative algorithm. We leave exploring this space for co-design to future work.

培训。Training.

接下来我们训练Next, we train33模型，每个模型都是具有层尺寸的 3 层 MLPmodels, each a 3 layer MLP with layer dimensions(3072,256)(3072,256), (256,256)(256,256), 和, and(256,10)(256,10)和 SiLU 激活。所有模型的初始化都是相同的。在原始 CIFAR 数据集上训练一个模型, and SiLU activations. All models are initialized identically. One model is trained on the original CIFAR datasetcifar10dataset，称为“原创”。另一个模型在转换后的 CIFAR 数据上进行训练，表示为“转换后”。我们还协调训练，以便在每个步骤中，转换模型看到的批次与原始模型看到的批次的转换版本完全对应。最后一个模型称为“嫁接”。所有模型同时训练。, called “Original." Another model is trained on the transformed CIFAR data, denoted “Transformed." We also coordinate training so that at each step, the batches the Transformed model sees corresponds exactly to the transformed version of the batches the Original model sees. The last model is called “Grafted." All models are trained simultaneously.

Grafted 模型的训练如下：在训练过程中，记录输入到 Transformed 模型每一层的激活，并计算它们的均值/协方差。然后，嫁接模型将原始数据批次作为输入。然后，在将数据传递给每层的权重之前，对传入的激活应用仿射变换，以将其均值和协方差与变换模型前向传递的缓存均值/协方差相匹配。The Grafted model is trained as follows: during training, the activations inputted into each layer of the Transformed model are recorded, and their means/covariances calculated. Then, the Grafted model takes as input the Original data batch. Then, before passing the data through each layer’s weights, an affine transform is applied to the incoming activations to match their mean and covariance to the cached means/covariances of the Transformed model’s forward pass.

最后，在每个训练步骤后，在转换后的数据上验证模型，并绘制验证损失。结果显示在Finally, the models are validated on the Transformed data after each training step, and the validation losses plotted. The results are displayed inFigure˜19.

尽管没有接受过转换数据的训练，但在优化器中，嫁接模型在转换数据上的验证性能与转换模型的匹配程度比原始模型（在原始数据上训练的）更接近，这表明当对具有相似均值和协方差的数据进行训练时，模型通常会进行类似的学习，即使数据本身并不完全匹配。虽然没有显示，但我们进一步注意到，增加批量大小和降低学习率都有助于提高嫁接模型在验证损失中与转换模型的拟合程度，因为它们减少了均值/协方差估计噪声和高阶不匹配引起的漂移。Despite not being trained on the Transformed data, the Grafted model’s validation performance on the transformed data matches much more closely with the Transformed model than the Original model (trained on the original data) across optimizers, suggesting that when trained on data with similar means and covariances, models often learn similarly, even if the data itself does not perfectly match. While not displayed, we further note that increasing batch size and decreasing learning rate both help to improve how closely the Grafted model fits the Transformed model in validation loss, as they reduce drift arising from mean/covariance estimation noise and higher-order mismatches from the非线性non-linear数据变换。值得注意的是，我们注意到，由于没有纠正机制将嫁接模型的权重移植到转换模型的“地面实况”权重上，因此漂移将在训练范围内单调复合。data transform. Notably, we remark that since there is no corrective mechanism to port the Grafted model’s weights onto the Transformed model’s “ground truth” weights, the drift will monotonically compound over the training horizon.

This lends credence to the premise ofAP，其中工作假设是“错误方向”（由每层激活的均值和协方差捕获）强烈偏向优化器的下游行为。嫁接表明，在假设的情况下，我们, where the working hypothesis is that “error directions” (as captured by the mean and covariance of each layer’s activations) strongly bias the optimizer’s downstream behavior. Grafting demonstrates that, in the hypothetical case where we知道knew“下游”模型的特征方向，我们可以将其偏差移植到训练分布上的训练上。然而，由于我们通常无法提前知道这些特征，the feature directions of the “downstream” model, we can graft its bias onto the training on the training distribution.
